spans.s: --a tribe of the Vindhya region. M. ११४. ५३.
(I)--a यक्ष; a son of पुण्यजनी and मणि- bhadra. Br.
(IV)--the forest of Padma between the Lau- hitya and the Sindhu. Br.
(I)--a name of श्री. भा. X. ४७. १३; Vi.
(II)--one of the ten पीठस् for images; with sixteen corners, a little short at the bottom; gives one good luck (सौभाग्य). M. २६२. 7, १६, १८.

--a palace with three भूमिकस् and sixteen sides;
1: M. २६९. ३९, ४३.
also श्रिवृक्षक; the तोरण is of २० hastas.
2: Ib. २६९. ४९.
--the vessel of the lotus leaf wherein the Gandharvas milked the cow-earth. M. १०. २४.
--a snake used as बलबन्धम् for Tri- पुरारि's chariot. M. १३३. ३३. [page२-284+ २५]
(I)--also जनार्दन; the God who per- vades all the worlds; lustrous as the sun and with bow as weapon. Br. II. १९. १७७-80; III. ३३. १७; IV. ३४. ८१.
(II)--a यक्ष; a son of देवजनी and मणिवर. Br.
--the Gandharvas and the Apsarasas milked the earth making Citraratha the calf; milkman शुची Vis4vavasu. वा. ६२. १८७.

--ब्रह्मा; a thousand leafed lotus came out of the navel of the Lord on the eve of the creation of the universe; it resembled the earth in form; in it were found all the countries, mountains, peoples, etc.
billions; ten times the शन्कु. M. २३. ३९; वा. १०१. १०१.
(II)--one of the eight निधिस् of Kubera. वा. ४१. १०.
--a यक्ष; a son of देवजनी and मणि- vara. Br.
--in the यज्ञस् after the world lotus of the Lord. M. १६९. १६ and १८.
(I)--the city of पुरञ्जय the capital of the नागस्. भा.
(II)--a daughter of भङ्गकार, who was given in marriage to कृष्ण. M. ४५. २१.
--a kind of आसन in yoga, once practised by परशुराम; of Kapila. Br. III. २४. १६; ५३. १७.

--(वृक्षोत्सव): dedication of trees and shrubs; same as तडागविधि; further oblations to Loka- पालस् and Vanaspati, decoration of trees with golden fruits, etc., to be given away to Brahmanas at the end; a festival in honour of trees and plants; lasts four days; he who does it attains heaven and is rarely returned to earth.
1: M. ५९. 1-१८.
If trees laugh or weep or flower in a wrong season they should be propitiated.
2: Ib. ch. २३२ (whole)
--the time of the night, calculated from the moment of the moon. वा. ६६. ४५.
--sandals to be given in वृक्षोत्सवम्; to be given as gift along with light, umbrella, seat, etc. M. ५९. १४; ७०. ४८; २७५. २५.
--succeeds ब्राह्म kalpa, then the lotus comes out of Hari's navel. भा. II. १०. ४७; III. ११. ३५; Vi.
